name: spamfilter-rspamd
description: rspamd scanner for the IMAP spam filter stack. Reads its `local.d` config from the mounted appdata directory. bootstrap.sh prepares a fully-rendered worker-controller.inc on the host beforehand (no env-var coordination needed at container start). Listens on 11333 (scan) and 11334 (control + web UI). Run bootstrap.sh once before installing this container.

paths.name: local.d configs
paths.description: Mounted read-only at /etc/rspamd/local.d. Filled by bootstrap.sh.

paths.name: rspamd state
paths.description: rspamd-managed runtime state (caches). Does not need backup.
